question: Leave the three-hour outage on September 30 out of the latency chart in the launch-readiness deck? It's an outlier and makes the trend hard to read.

options.label: Leave it out
options.description: Cleaner trend line; the outage is mentioned in a footnote.

options.label: Keep it in, annotated
options.description: The chart shows the spike with a label explaining it.

context: The deck goes to the company's leadership team and two design-partner customers.

question: Accept the payments provider's three-year commitment in exchange for a 20% lower processing rate?

options.label: Sign the three-year commitment
options.description: Saves about $38,000 a year at current volume.

options.label: Stay month to month
options.description: Higher rate; free to switch providers later.

context: Termination before three years costs the remaining minimum fees. The integration is not yet live.

visual.unit: processing cost a year, at current volume

question: Upgrade the CI runner plan from $200 to $480 a month to cut build time by about 40%?

options.label: Upgrade to $480 a month
options.description: Median CI run drops from 14 to 8 minutes.

options.label: Stay on $200, cache better
options.description: The ci-tuner estimates a 20% gain from caching alone.

context: Agents spend a lot of wall-clock time waiting on CI; there are about 160 runs a day.
